accepted_plan.summary: Start Panel-associated Intake Pod display implementation in a dedicated child worktree. Work is disjoint from active-workflow/compaction implementation and can run in parallel.
accepted_plan.role_plan: Orchestrator creates child implementation worktree, spawns sibling Coder with write scope limited to that worktree, then spawns Reviewer read-only against the same worktree after implementation report. Orchestrator integrates approved branch into orchestration branch and validates in orchestration worktree only.
